patients.question: How do I download the app?
patients.answer: The OmniCare app is available on the App Store and Google Play. Tap the relevant button, then follow the instructions.

patients.question: How do I create my account?
patients.answer: Download the app, then create your account in a few seconds with your email.

patients.question: Is my data protected?
patients.answer: Yes. Your health data is stored securely and confidentially.

patients.question: How do I pay for my consultation?
patients.answer: Payment happens inside the app, in a simple and secure way.

professionals.question: How do I request access?
professionals.answer: Fill in the access request form. Our team verifies your profile, then creates your account.

professionals.question: What is the verification process?
professionals.answer: We verify your professional information before creating your account. Verification is fast.

professionals.question: Can I manage my own schedule?
professionals.answer: Yes, you freely organise your availability from your professional space.

professionals.question: Is support available?
professionals.answer: Yes, a dedicated team supports every professional.

about.metaDescription: OmniCare is a Tunisian health app designed to bring patients and health professionals closer, across Tunisia.
about.story1Body: OmniCare was born from a simple observation: accessing healthcare in Tunisia can be difficult, time-consuming and at times discouraging. Between queues, travel and time constraints, many Tunisians give up on seeing a health professional.
about.story1Alt: A phone and a stethoscope: simpler access to care
about.story2Body: Our mission is to bring patients and health professionals closer through a mobile app: consultations, booking, medical records, prescriptions and follow-up — designed for everyday life, for patients and for professionals.
about.story3Body: Accessible, modern and effective healthcare for everyone in Tunisia. OmniCare is technology in the service of people: quality care, wherever you are, whenever you need it.
